Title: Azure Container Registry on Azure Stack Hub private preview

Body.Content:
A private preview of Azure Container Registry on Azure Stack Hub will be available later this year. This service uses private container registries on Azure Stack Hub to store and retrieve OCI-compliant images to support both connected and disconnected scenarios for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) engine, AKS, and other container orchestrator engines.

Learn more
